name: Postgres MCP Pro
summary: Open-source Postgres MCP server with database health checks, index tuning, EXPLAIN plans with hypothetical indexes, schema intelligence and safe, configurable SQL execution.
description: Access modes include unrestricted and read-only with safe SQL parsing, so it can be pointed at development or production databases. Supports stdio and SSE transports. Installs from PyPI as `postgres-mcp` or via Docker.
